text: Karyali-3 Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Karyali-3 Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Punjab District: Layyah Period: Proto Historic Relative Chronology: 3500 BCE - 1800 BCE Description: An archaeological site in ruined condition exhibiting applique pottery of light and dark red colours was associated with the Hakra phase along with some finely made grey potshards, with or without slip. Signs of burnishing on some of them also have been observed.
